effect.name: Stencil Clip
effect.description: Shows the object only where the background behind it is a particular colour. Paint a mask colour into your level art and sprites will only draw inside it - water that only fills the pool, light that only lands on the floor, a reflection that stops at the edge of the puddle.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Stencil Colour
parameter.description: The background colour the object is allowed to draw over. Default is magenta, the traditional 'this is not real art' colour.

parameter.name: Tolerance
parameter.description: How close the background has to be to the stencil colour. 0 is an exact match.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: Fades the clip out past the tolerance instead of cutting hard.

parameter.name: Invert
parameter.description: On draws everywhere except over the stencil colour.
